title: kcapi_do_hkdf PRK stack buffer sized to 64 (SHA-512) with overflow check
description: kcapi_kdf.c: u8 prk[64] on stack with digestsize > sizeof(prk) guard. The buffer is large enough for SHA-512 (64 bytes); the guard is defensive but cannot trigger for the registered sha256/384/512 transforms. A contributor might suggest replacing with kmalloc(digestsize) to 'be safe' — this adds a heap allocation per KDF call inside the hot path and is unnecessary since the transforms are statically known. The stack buffer + guard is the correct tradeoff.
close_reason: Code verified correct. Design decisions implemented as described.
